context.stage: Stage F1 - Application Shell and Authentication

task.description:
Produce a design artefact at src/design/shell-f1.md for Stage F1 requirements SH-01 through SH-04. The design must cover: (1) token-based login flow replacing email/password (SH-01), (2) in-memory token storage replacing localStorage (FNFR-06 compliance, SH-02), (3) role-aware navigation sidebar for all 4 roles: PLATFORM_ADMIN, PROCESS_DESIGNER, PROCESS_OPERATOR, TASK_WORKER (SH-03), (4) user header showing display_name and roles with logout (SH-04). All public function/component signatures must be listed. Do NOT write implementation code.

REWORK 1:
- [MAJOR] SH-02 has a conflict: FNFR-06 says never in localStorage/sessionStorage, but SH-02 MUST says persist across page reloads. Resolution: (a) document this as an Open Constraint in the design artefact, (b) choose the secure-by-default approach (in-memory only, no cross-reload persistence), (c) note that full SH-02 compliance requires backend httpOnly-cookie support which is not yet implemented, and (d) document the fallback: user re-enters token after page reload. Update src/design/shell-f1.md with an Open Constraints section that explicitly describes this tradeoff.
acceptance_criteria: Design covers all 4 acceptance criteria above
Security notes on token storage (in-memory only, not localStorage)
JWT decode plan documented (atob on payload segment)
Role-to-nav-item matrix documented for all 4 roles

result.summary: Added Open Constraints section (OC-01) documenting SH-02 vs FNFR-06 conflict; updated section 7 to explicitly state token storage variable, page-reload redirect to /login?reason=session-expired, and session-expired banner trigger; updated section 4.6 and data flow diagram to use URL query param instead of React Router state for session-expired detection.
